post.summary: Processes a SAP integration response and updates the corresponding accounting batch movements. For each movement ID provided, the observation and optionally the control code are updated. If a message is provided, it is stored as the movement observation. If no message is provided, the objectKey is stored as the observation and the control code is extracted from the objectKey using the 'HABC' delimiter.
post.description: Processes a SAP integration response and updates the corresponding accounting batch movements. For each movement ID provided, the observation and optionally the control code are updated. If a message is provided, it is stored as the movement observation. If no message is provided, the objectKey is stored as the observation and the control code is extracted from the objectKey using the 'HABC' delimiter.
